purpose: Restore canonical Aurora, Eclipse and Rainbow identities and proportions in birthday panels.

entries.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Image 1 is the edit target birthday comic scene. Images 2, 3, 4 are the ORIGINAL canonical character designs: Aurora, Eclipse, Rainbow respectively. Correct character-design drift in image 1, using these originals as strict model sheets, not merely loose style inspiration.
Aurora is the SECOND astronaut from left, Eclipse the THIRD astronaut from left. Rainbow stands just right of the cake, behind the white rabbit.
The target currently turns these characters into generic small-faced human toddlers with tall bodies. Restore the ORIGINAL head shape and head-to-body ratio: very large broad rounded head, short compact tiny body, tiny limbs, almost no visible neck. Match each canonical face's exact proportions, oversized purple eyes and iris shapes, eye spacing, forehead, cheeks, small mouth, hairline and sculpted hair shapes. Keep their individual identities instead of homogenizing the three.
Aurora: restore the sweeping PINK sculpted hair and side locks (not lavender braids), broad pale pink face, original large purple eyes, gold star forehead with white filigree. Eclipse: restore the original pale lavender broad face, purple eyes, distinctive pointed silver-lilac central curl, dark sparkling angular hairline and silver side locks. These two MUST KEEP their existing yellow space suits, yellow cat-ear helmets, clear visors and rocket backpacks. Resize their suit torsos to be appropriately tiny below their heads. Do not add their reference crowns or dresses to the astronaut outfits. Do not change brown-haired blue-eyed Odette at all.
Rainbow: match image 4 exactly in face proportions, big purple-pink eyes with star and heart highlights, red heart in gold diamond forehead ornament, correctly shaped large three-point jeweled gold crown, generous swept pink-purple bangs and flowing blue/yellow/pink/purple hair, original pink/teal/cream gold-trimmed dress, tiny purple shoes, original heart wand. Her head is large and torso short, no tall thin body. Preserve her current activity and general position.
Preserve every OTHER character and helper, their count, positions and identities; preserve scene composition, cake, candles, balloons, castle, lighting, empty bottom foreground floor and landscape aspect ratio. Do not add duplicate characters, no text, no watermark. Make only the specified identity corrections. Same polished dimensional children's animation rendering.

additionalProportionPass.prompt:
Targeted proportion correction. Image 1 is scene to edit, images 2 and 3 are exact original Aurora and Eclipse model sheets.
Only edit the SECOND and THIRD astronauts from the left (pink-haired Aurora and lavender-haired Eclipse). Their bodies are STILL too tall compared to canonical heads. Keep boots at same floor level, but SHORTEN their yellow suit bodies AND legs by about 35 percent and move their heads down to sit directly on their small shoulders. Enlarge their heads 15 percent, keeping pink swept hair, star filigree, silver pointed curl, original broad faces and purple eyes exact to model sheets. Overall they should be visibly squat round fairy mascots roughly 1.7 heads tall excluding cat-ear helmet points: head is about 60% of total height, short torso and very short legs combined are 40%. Hands tiny and stubby. Keep yellow suits and clear cat-ear helmets, yellow bows and back rockets; do not introduce crowns or dresses. Odette on far left must remain completely unchanged.
Preserve ALL other pixels/composition as closely as possible: Rainbow, remaining friends, floating helpers, cake, castle, floor and lighting. Keep the current wide canvas and unoccupied foreground. No text.

compositing: Original guest images composited unchanged with compose-birthday.py and compose-birthday-photo.py using --revision v2.
